name: Gay Zodiac
source:
You wake up to a text from your friend in the middle of the night, there seems to be a party happening at the Air Brotherhood. What will you do? Will you fix your current relationship with your boyfriend? Or will you give up and find love somewhere else?

[From [url=https://pomegranateclub.itch.io/gay-zodiac]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
半夜你被朋友发来的短信吵醒，空中兄弟会似乎正在举办一场聚会。你会怎么做？你会修复你和男朋友目前的关系吗？或者你会放弃并在其他地方寻找爱情吗？

[来自[url=https://pomegranateclub.itch.io/gay-zodiac]itch.io[/url]]
